title: Nice with room of improvement.
body:
I like using this app because it is user-friendly and allows yearly habits.
I hope there is a dark mode available and the graphics can improve.
author: Myinena

title: Love it but can I turn the splash screen off?
body: Love the program in every way except the splash screen. Not to say it's not a good photo, but it's a loading delay I'd prefer not to have...
author: RX71912

title: Crushing my goals
body: This app is keeping me accountable for the goals I have set for myself. I LOVE IT!!!
author: Stevie2easy
